title: A Degree-Independent Rhombus Criterion in Three Variables, and the Higher-Dimensional Boundary
oneLine: A factor-3 rhombus condition is proposed as a degree-independent ternary stability criterion, while three higher-dimensional readings meet explicit obstructions and the normalized cases in four through six variables remain open.
abstract: This anonymous, unrefereed candidate addresses AIM-LINEAR_ALGEBRA-0011. For positive homogeneous ternary polynomials, it argues that Branden-oriented elementary rhombus quotients at least 3 imply real stability in every degree. The proof replaces a degree-dependent multiplicity estimate by two convergent theta-type sums. The higher-dimensional request is separated into three formulations. Coordinate-face inequalities fail for every prescribed finite factor from four variables onward; one precisely quantified strict multiplicative exchange margin is inconsistent on positive full-support quadratics; and normalized M-concavity fails in unrestricted dimension from seven variables onward through finite positive families converging to the prior-art Fano obstruction. The normalized cases with four, five and six variables are not classified. Deterministic producer replay, semantic mutations, internal role-separated review and a fully actioned supplied review reached PASS_WITH_NOTES. No historical-priority, unaffiliated-reproduction, formal-verification, specialist-review or peer-review claim is made.
narration: Rhombus inequalities compare four nearby coefficients of a homogeneous polynomial. A known theorem says that, in three variables, sufficiently strong inequalities force real stability, but its required factor grows with the degree. This anonymous, unrefereed candidate argues that the fixed factor three works in every degree. The proof normalizes the coefficient array, pairs terms by parity, and bounds the resulting multiplicities with two convergent series. The phrase rhombus condition becomes ambiguous in more variables, so the paper tests three precise extensions separately. Coordinate-face inequalities cannot work with any finite universal factor once there are at least four variables. One strict multiplicative exchange rule is internally inconsistent for positive full-support quadratics. A normalized discrete-concavity version is meaningful, but a finite positive family approaching the known Fano obstruction rules it out from seven variables onward. The normalized cases in four, five and six variables remain open. The package includes exact producer replay, hostile mutations, source mapping and internal review. These checks do not establish an independent proof, formal verification, external specialist review, journal peer review or historical priority. The synthetic-voice briefing is a communication aid, not additional mathematical evidence.

problem.name: AIM Problem 1.1: degree-independent rhombus criteria and higher-dimensional extensions

keyResults: For every degree d at least 1, factor-3 Branden-oriented elementary rhombus inequalities are argued to imply real stability for positive ternary homogeneous polynomials.
For every m at least 4 and every prescribed finite factor, an explicit positive quadratic family satisfies all coordinate-face rhombus bounds but is not real-stable.
The precisely defined uniform one-exchange multiplicative margin q greater than 1 is inconsistent for positive full-support quadratics once four distinct indices occur.
The normalized M-concavity formulation fails in unrestricted dimension from m=7 onward via finite positive families converging to the prior-art Fano obstruction.
The normalized cases m=4,5,6 and the optimal ternary constant remain open in this release.
evidence: A 12-page canonical candidate manuscript and accessible derivatives; a five-claim machine registry; a source bridge identifying every external theorem used; written proofs of the universal ternary statement and symbolic obstruction families; exact Python identity and mutation checks in normal and optimized modes; exact C++ enumeration of 880 M-convex supports plus a bounded long-double scan; architecture-specific receipts; deterministic PDF reconstruction; a complete 59-file manifest; a fully actioned supplied review; a five-role producer-coordinated internal review; and a bounded confirmation. Digest-pinned local replay and public GitHub Actions reproduce the declared receipts and reject altered artifacts. GitHub and Zenodo release bytes match exactly. These establish public availability, integrity, producer replay and the declared finite computations—not an independent proof of the universal theorem, historical priority, unaffiliated reproduction, formal verification, external specialist review or peer review.
statusDetail: Anonymous, AI-assisted and unrefereed partial mathematics candidate at internal PASS_WITH_NOTES. The degree-independent ternary theorem and higher-dimensional families are written arguments; the finite scripts audit identities, indexing and declared bounded searches but do not prove the universal statements. The Fano non-stability obstruction is prior work. The normalized dimensions four through six remain open, the constant 3 is not claimed optimal, and the bounded novelty search does not establish priority.
